name: What steps are involved in the interior painting process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the interior painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our interior painting process typically includes surface preparation (cleaning, patching, sanding), priming (if necessary), applying two coats of paint, and a final inspection. We also ensure thorough protection of your belongings and meticulous cleanup after the project is complete, leaving your space neat and refreshed.
acceptedAnswer.description: The interior painting process involves surface preparation, priming, applying two paint coats, a final inspection, and thorough cleanup.
